moments.title: Adam Ant turns 72
moments.blurb: English new wave icon Adam Ant, known for hits with Adam and the Ants and a successful solo career, celebrates his 72nd birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: New Wave King
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the dandy highwayman himself, Adam Ant! Still got those Kings of the Wild Frontier vibes. What's your favourite Adam Ant track?

angles.name: Antmusic
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Adam Ant turns 72! From 'Stand and Deliver' to 'Prince Charming', his music defined an era. Which song takes you back?
